blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs’ (BOC) Customs Processing System (CPS), a digital platform designed to fully digitize import and export transactions, is expected to be rolled out in June or July next year, BOC Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno said on Wednesday. Nepomuceno said the system is one of 15 proposed BOC projects aimed at modernizing and digitizing the agency. He likened the CPS to an automated teller machine, saying importers and exporters would no longer have to transact directly with Customs officials but could instead scan and submit their documents digitally. “Once it is rolled out, expect the effects of […]...
